title: Embrittlement in Tungsten Alloys Under Ion Irradiations Simulating Damage of Fusion Reactors
content: Tungsten alloys are promising plasma-facing materials due to their high melting point, excellent thermal conductivity, and mechanical strength, as well as their low sputtering yield at low plasma temperatures. However, their inherent brittleness, which is further exacerbated by exposure to the fusion reactor environment, remains a major concern.
